notes.title: Big update! New Levels and More!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26589316/0aac894162a6bc4e1d89aa53b1ecee69cfcbaf22.png[/img]
[b]A new update has been released! Get ready and grab your plunger![/b]

[h1]Update includes completely new levels:[/h1]
[b][u]Grandma's Toilet[/u][/b] - New job in the grandma's bathroom is hard and the neighbour isn't helping, but fear not, you can get diamond pipes.

[b][u]School Madness[/u][/b] - Toilets bursting with poop! Use Golden Poop from GOLDCORN MACHINE to stop the flooding.

[b][u]Double Duck[/u][/b] - What the duck?! Public toilet is less forgiving than the school's, but you can upgrade pipes to gold.

[h1]New Mode:[/h1]
[b][u]Pooper Shooter![/u][/b] (UNDER CONSTRUCTION)
Get the Plungers and the Piperbow!
They're coming...



Trading Cards and even more to come.. Stay tuned!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26589316/0d41872d986d0c4d1dcdb7394902c7af213fb466.png[/img]
